columns.comment: Calendar date (primary key; facts join their date key here).
columns.name: date

columns.comment: Date as an integer yyyymmdd (e.g. 20260930).
columns.name: date_key

columns.comment: Calendar year.
columns.name: calendar_year

columns.comment: Calendar month number 1-12.
columns.name: calendar_month

columns.comment: Calendar quarter 1-4 (Jan-Mar = 1). Use fiscal_quarter for Japanese fiscal quarters.
columns.name: calendar_quarter

columns.comment: Three-letter month name (Jan ... Dec).
columns.name: month_name

columns.comment: Calendar month as yyyy-MM (e.g. 2026-09).
columns.name: calendar_month_label

columns.comment: Day of the month 1-31.
columns.name: day_of_month

columns.comment: Day of week 1-7 with 1 = Sunday and 7 = Saturday.
columns.name: day_of_week

columns.comment: Three-letter weekday name (Mon ... Sun).
columns.name: day_name

columns.comment: First day of the calendar month.
columns.name: month_start_date

columns.comment: Last calendar day of the month.
columns.name: month_end_date

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as its starting calendar year (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label, e.g. FY2026 (Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: First day of the fiscal year (1 April).
columns.name: fiscal_year_start_date

columns.comment: Last day of the fiscal year (31 March).
columns.name: fiscal_year_end_date

columns.comment: Fiscal quarter 1-4 (Q1 Apr-Jun, Q2 Jul-Sep, Q3 Oct-Dec, Q4 Jan-Mar).
columns.name: fiscal_quarter

columns.comment: Fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_quarter_label

columns.comment: Fiscal half, H1 (Apr-Sep) or H2 (Oct-Mar).
columns.name: fiscal_half

columns.comment: Fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1 (Apr-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_half_label

columns.comment: Fiscal month number 1-12 with April = 1 and March = 12.
columns.name: fiscal_month_no

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (month-end snapshot date).
columns.name: is_month_end

columns.comment: True on the last day of a fiscal quarter (30 Jun, 30 Sep, 31 Dec, 31 Mar).
columns.name: is_quarter_end

columns.comment: True on 31 March, the Japanese fiscal year-end.
columns.name: is_fiscal_year_end

columns.comment: True on Saturday or Sunday.
columns.name: is_weekend

columns.comment: True on a Singapore business day (Monday-Friday; same rule as the source calendar).
columns.name: is_business_day_sg

columns.comment: True on the last Monday-Friday of the month.
columns.name: is_last_business_day_of_month

columns.comment: Days between this date and the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 (0 = as-of, positive = past, negative = future). Last N days = days_before_as_of between 0 and N-1.
columns.name: days_before_as_of

columns.comment: Months between this date's month and the as-of month (0 = Sep 2026, -1 = Aug 2026, +1 = Oct 2026).
columns.name: month_offset

columns.comment: True only on the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 ("today").
columns.name: is_as_of_date

columns.comment: True for dates after the as-of date (forecast / maturity horizon).
columns.name: is_future

columns.comment: True for days of the as-of month (Sep 2026).
columns.name: is_latest_month

columns.comment: True for days of the latest closed month (Sep 2026, closed at the as-of date).
columns.name: is_latest_closed_month

columns.comment: True for fiscal-year-to-date days of the as-of fiscal year (1-Apr-2026 to 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: is_fytd

columns.comment: True for the same fiscal-year-to-date window one year earlier (1-Apr-2025 to 30-Sep-2025) - the YoY comparison base.
columns.name: is_prior_fytd_same_period

comment: Calendar from 1-Apr-2023 to 31-Mar-2027 with Japanese fiscal-year fields (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027; Q1 Apr-Jun, Q2 Jul-Sep, Q3 Oct-Dec, Q4 Jan-Mar; H1 Apr-Sep, H2 Oct-Mar) and flags relative to the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 (H1 FY2026 close, the demo "today" - never use CURRENT_DATE). Date keys of gold facts reference dim_date.date. Grain: one row per calendar day.
